title: How to Clean the Filter in a Dishwasher
author: Written byKeyonda Bradleyon Dec 19, 2009
steps: Start out with an empty dishwasher. Remove the bottom rack and locate the filter. The filter is usually on the floor of the dishwasher.

Once the filter has been located, take a damp cloth and clean around the area. Be sure to remove all the debris. If you have a dishwasher that has a closed filter, unscrew the filter and remove the debris located inside.

After you have cleaned the filter, mix together ½ cup of baking soda, ½ cup of salt and one cup of bleach. Pour this mixture into the bottom of the dishwasher and allow it to sit overnight. In the morning set your dishwasher to run a normal wash without any dishes in it to complete the cleaning process. Cleaning the filter in a dishwasheris often an overlooked task. Use this guide to keep yours in like-new condition.
